run_elasticity_calculation: run calculate_elasticity to compute the elastic tensor, bulk modulus, and shear modulus for an ASE Atoms structure
run_elasticity_with_custom_strains: run calculate_elasticity with custom normal and shear strain values to control deformation magnitude
run_elasticity_without_relaxation: run calculate_elasticity with relax_initial and relax_strained set to False to skip all relaxation steps
run_elasticity_without_equilibrium_stres: run calculate_elasticity with use_equilibrium_stress set to False to omit equilibrium stress from the calculation
review_elasticity_results: review the calculate_elasticity function to understand how it uses pymatgen ElasticTensor and DeformedStructureSet for VRH modulus computation
